releases.notes:
First build of Catify for **Minecraft 26.1.2**.

## Requirements
- Minecraft `26.1.2`
- Fabric Loader `>=0.19.3`
- Java `25` or newer
- Fabric API

## Install
Drop `catify-1.0.3.jar` into your `mods` folder. Client-side only and purely cosmetic.

## Notes on this port
Fabric stopped publishing Yarn mappings at 1.21.11, so this build is based on Mojang official mappings. Beyond the toolchain move (Loom 1.17, Java 25, Gradle 9.5.1), 26.1 changed real API surface:

- `CatModel` was split into `AdultCatModel` / `BabyCatModel` over a new `AbstractFelineModel` hierarchy
- GUI and level render states moved under `client.renderer.state.*`
- `displayClientMessage` split into `sendSystemMessage` / `sendOverlayMessage`
- Fabric API renamed its own classes to match Mojang mappings
- Vanilla cat textures gained a `cat_` prefix

Verified to build cleanly and load with no mixin failures, reaching the main menu with example texture extraction working. In-world rendering has not been visually tested yet, so please report anything that looks off.
